questions.question: What is the total size of the French Individual Health Insurance (IHI) market in 2024, in euros?
questions.ground_truth_answer: EUR 21.5 billion, with seniors accounting for approximately 83% of the individual segment.
questions.notes: Single-page factual, value appears in title and body of the slide.

questions.question: Who are Brand-N's main competitors according to broker interviews?
questions.ground_truth_answer: April, Kereis Solutions, Apivia, and Zenioo are mentioned as Brand-N's main competitors.

questions.question: What was the growth rate of the French Credit Protection Insurance (CPI) market between 2019 and 2023, and what is the 2023 total premium volume?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The CPI market grew by approximately 3% p.a. between 2019 and 2023, reaching EUR 7.9 billion in 2023.
questions.notes: Two-part question: rate AND value. The 3% figure appears in the slide title, 7.9Bn in body.

questions.question: What is Target Co.'s expected 2025 gross revenue (2025e) in euros?
questions.notes: Top financial KPI, repeated in executive summary (p.23 and p.26) and BP slide (p.53).

questions.question: What proportion of Target Co.'s total net revenues are recurring, and what are the main components?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Recurring revenues represent approximately 67% of total net revenues. Key recurring components include contract & claim management (~24%), recurring commissions (~18%), and other revenues (~25%); upfront net of clawback (~29%) is the main non-recurring component.

questions.question: What is Target Co.'s EBITDA margin in 2025e and how has it evolved historically?
questions.ground_truth_answer: EBITDA margin reached approximately 41% in 2025e (described as 'robust ~40%'), up from 24% in 2017. EBITDA grew at +20.4% p.a. between 2017 and 2025e, with key drivers including contract management internalization, AI-powered efficiency, and best-in-class cross-selling.
questions.notes: Multi-part: current value + trajectory + drivers. Same slide appears twice in the doc (p.27 in Exec Summary, p.70 in Business Overview).

questions.question: What is Target Co.'s total headcount as of August 2025, and how is it distributed across functions?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Total headcount is 677 FTEs as of August 2025, broken down as: contract management 361 FTEs (53%), B2C acquisition 189 FTEs (28%), B2B 97 FTEs (14%), and support functions 30 FTEs (4%).
questions.notes: Operational KPI on a single slide.

questions.question: What is Target Co.'s 2030 revenue target, both organic and including M&A?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Management targets over EUR 250 million by 2030 including M&A, with approximately EUR 210 million organically, reflecting a sustained ~10.5% annual growth.
questions.notes: Two distinct figures (with/without M&A) on the same slide.

questions.question: What is Target Co.'s dependency on offshore service providers, particularly OffshorePartner-A, and what share of total headcount does this represent?
questions.ground_truth_answer: OffshorePartner-A is Target Co.'s main offshore partner, with platforms accounting for approximately 56% of total FTEs (out of 677 total as of August 2025). Target Co.'s own onshore French workforce represents ~39% (especially strategic functions). The remaining ~5% is split across other providers (OffshorePartner-C, OffshorePartner-B, Other). This is a significant operational concentration risk.
questions.notes: Page 227 has the explicit consolidated breakdown; p.219 has the function-by-entity view. Either page is a valid citation.
